lessons.title: Isteach, istigh, amach, amuigh
lessons.en: In and out: moving or staying put
lessons.rule: Use isteach (in) and amach (out) when someone is moving; use istigh (inside) and amuigh (outside) when someone is already there and staying put.
steps: Ask whether Dara is moving or staying put: chuaigh (went) means moving.
He is moving into the library, so use isteach.
Write the sentence: Chuaigh Dara isteach sa leabharlann ag am lóin.

example.prompt: Chuaigh Dara ________ sa leabharlann ag am lóin.
example.answer: Chuaigh Dara isteach sa leabharlann ag am lóin.

more.prompt: Anois tá sé ________ ag obair ar an ríomhaire.
more.answer: Anois tá sé istigh ag obair ar an ríomhaire.

lessons.hint: Moving: isteach, amach. Staying put: istigh, amuigh.

items.prompt: Rith an gasúr ________ as an scoil nuair a bhuail an clog.
items.answer: Rith an gasúr amach as an scoil nuair a bhuail an clog.

items.prompt: Cá bhfuil Méabh? Tá sí ________ sa seomra ranga ag caint leis an mhúinteoir.
items.answer: Cá bhfuil Méabh? Tá sí istigh sa seomra ranga ag caint leis an mhúinteoir.

items.prompt: Shiúil Róise ________ as an siopa agus a fón ina lámh.
items.answer: Shiúil Róise amach as an siopa agus a fón ina lámh.

items.prompt: Shiúil Máirtín amach as an teach. Anois tá sé ________ sa ghairdín.
items.answer: Shiúil Máirtín amach as an teach. Anois tá sé amuigh sa ghairdín.

items.prompt: Chuaigh Aoife ________ sa teach. Anois tá sí istigh.
items.answer: Chuaigh Aoife isteach sa teach. Anois tá sí istigh.

lessons.title: Suas, thuas, anuas
lessons.en: Up: going up, up there, coming down
lessons.rule: Use suas for going up, away from the speaker; thuas for being up there and staying put; anuas for coming down towards the speaker.
steps: Ask whether Ciara is moving or staying put: ag dul (going) means moving.
She is going upwards, away from us, so use suas.
Write the sentence: Tá Ciara ag dul suas Sliabh gCuillinn lena rang.

example.prompt: Tá Ciara ag dul ________ Sliabh gCuillinn lena rang.
example.answer: Tá Ciara ag dul suas Sliabh gCuillinn lena rang.

more.prompt: Tá sí ag teacht ________ arís mar tá an bus ag fanacht.
more.answer: Tá sí ag teacht anuas arís mar tá an bus ag fanacht.

lessons.hint: Going up: suas. Up there: thuas. Coming down to us: anuas.

items.prompt: Chuaigh Rang 9 ________ an staighre go dtí an seomra ríomhairí i ndiaidh an tsosa.
items.answer: Chuaigh Rang 9 suas an staighre go dtí an seomra ríomhairí i ndiaidh an tsosa.

items.prompt: Chuaigh Pól suas an staighre. Anois tá sé ________ staighre.
items.answer: Chuaigh Pól suas an staighre. Anois tá sé thuas staighre.

items.prompt: Tá Pól ag teacht ________ an staighre don dinnéar.
items.answer: Tá Pól ag teacht anuas an staighre don dinnéar.

items.prompt: Tá an cat ________ ar bharr an bhalla.
items.answer: Tá an cat thuas ar bharr an bhalla.

lessons.title: Síos, thíos, aníos
lessons.en: Down: going down, down there, coming up
lessons.rule: Use síos for going down, away from the speaker; thíos for being down there and staying put; aníos for coming up towards the speaker from below.
steps: Ask whether Aoibhinn is moving or staying put: ag dul (going) means moving.
She is going downwards, away from us, so use síos.
Write the sentence: Tá Aoibhinn ag dul síos go dtí an pháirc don chluiche camógaíochta.

example.prompt: Tá Aoibhinn ag dul ________ go dtí an pháirc don chluiche camógaíochta.
example.answer: Tá Aoibhinn ag dul síos go dtí an pháirc don chluiche camógaíochta.

more.prompt: Anois tá sí ________ sa pháirc agus tá an cluiche ag tosú.
more.answer: Anois tá sí thíos sa pháirc agus tá an cluiche ag tosú.

lessons.hint: Going down: síos. Down there: thíos. Coming up to us: aníos.

items.prompt: Tá sí ag teacht ________ arís i ndiaidh an chluiche.
items.answer: Tá sí ag teacht aníos arís i ndiaidh an chluiche.

items.prompt: Chuaigh an rang ________ go bun an chnoic.
items.answer: Chuaigh an rang síos go bun an chnoic.

items.prompt: Tá siad ________ ag bun an chnoic anois.
items.answer: Tá siad thíos ag bun an chnoic anois.

items.prompt: Tá na gasúir ag teacht ________ ón trá.
items.answer: Tá na gasúir ag teacht aníos ón trá.

tables.title: A. suas, thuas, anuas
forms: suas: going up, away from you
